from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/farhan-ali-waris-gham-e-hussain-dilam-balochi-nw-2407e3690828.md')
original = p.read_bytes()
opening = \"\"\"Maula Maula Maula Husain
Maula Maula Maula Husain
Maula Maula Maula Maula Husain
Maula Maula Maula Maula Husain
Husain Husain Husain Maula
Husain Husain Husain Maula
Ae mai paighaame jahaan aar
Ae mai paighaame jahaan aar
Ae mai paighaame jahaan aar\"\"\"
refrain = \"\"\"Daar dilaam
Dilaam daar dilaam daar dilaam
Gham-e-Husain dilaam dilaam daar dilaam\"\"\"
response = \"\"\"Gham-e-Husain daare
Anrazi chhammaamu biyaare
Maula raazi baiye shuwaaraash\"\"\"
stanzas = [
    \"\"\"Aahni majlis pachaare
Pyaas ni pyaas saare
Maula go wafa khanne
Hama yaada shuwa biyaare\"\"\",
    \"\"\"Shahidaaṅ hune khatha
Hama bi sa khaak-e-shifa
Maaṅ jo sajda khuzaa'uṅ
Aakhta thai yaad mana\"\"\",
    \"\"\"Gham-e-Akbar mazaaiṅ
Gham-e-Asghar mazaaiṅ
Gham-e-Zainab mazaaiṅ
Gham-e-chaadar mazaaiṅ\"\"\",
    \"\"\"Khaali gham maaṅ na khuzaa'uṅ
Hameṅ nabiyaaṅ da khuza
Nokh istaare khuza
Hameṅ waliyaaṅ da khuza\"\"\",
    \"\"\"Qaadir Shaah likh so rowe
Bas hameṅ Shaah ni gham
Umr bhar nauha parhaaṅ
Zur tho Farhaan qasam\"\"\",
]
blocks = ['\\n'.join((opening, refrain, refrain, response, refrain))]
for number, stanza in enumerate(stanzas, 1):
    blocks.append('\\n'.join((str(number), stanza, response, refrain)))
blocks.append('Gushe')

front, body = original.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)
source_blocks = body.decode().split('۔۔۔۔۔۔۔۔۔')
assert len(source_blocks) == len(blocks)
for index, (source, roman) in enumerate(zip(source_blocks, blocks)):
    source_lines = [line for line in source.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.lstrip().startswith('(')]
    roman_lines = [line for line in roman.splitlines() if not line.isdecimal()]
    assert len(source_lines) == len(roman_lines), (index, len(source_lines), len(roman_lines))

roman_yaml = '\\n'.join('  ' + line if line else '' for line in '\\n\\n'.join(blocks).splitlines())
updated = front.replace(b'tags: [\"noRoman\"]', b'tags: []') + b'\\nromanLyrics: |-\\n' + roman_yaml.encode() + b'\\n---\\n' + body
p.write_bytes(updated)
assert p.read_bytes().split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1] == body
print('Verified 72 Roman verse lines across the opening, five stanzas, and closing cue. Body matches byte for byte.')
